section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Effects on learning strategies', details the results of regression analyses for Study 2. It examines the hypothesized effects of MAP and PAP goals on various learning strategies (deep learning, interest-based studying, surface learning, vigilant approach) and the mediating role of utility value. The results largely support hypotheses for PAP goals predicting surface learning and vigilant approach, and unexpectedly deep learning, while MAP goals predicted deep learning.
